summary: HF Foods Group filed an 8-K/A (Amendment No. 1) supplying audited and pro forma financials for its previously completed acquisition of Canadian poultry suppliers Searay Foods Inc. and Morgan Foods Inc. The deal, signed July 17, 2026 and closed August 31, 2026, transferred 100% of the target group for a base price of CAD$47.9 million, comprising CAD$38.4 million cash plus 1,701,871 HFFG shares priced at US$4.00, placed in escrow subject to earn-out conditions. Net working capital was also acquired. Watch earn-out triggers, escrow release and integration of the Canadian protein distribution business.
